transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1596 Pathfield Drive?

Yes, this is 1596 Pathfield Drive.  
We’re three people here, no water inside, and we can help—just need two seats.
Address confirmed. You’re not alone here. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Three people total. Everyone can come to the phone.

Thanks for letting us know everyone can come to the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave alone. No wheelchairs or oxygen here.
Understood, no one is unable to leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat. Two seats free in my car.
Got it, two free seats in your car. Let me read that back: 3 people; no water inside yet; you can help with 2 free seats. Is that right?
Yes. Three people. No water. Two seats free.

Got it, thanks for confirming. I've recorded that you may be able to help neighbors. A dispatcher may contact you. Only go out if it's safe for you, and never drive into water you can't see the bottom of. Goodbye.
